sources.grain: one instance, event, or trace-span record
sources.notes: Private first-party OLTP source, normally ~/.dsco/baseline.db. The adapter uses SQLite online backup and excludes raw event detail while retaining hashes and routing telemetry. SPDX licensing is not applicable to private operational data.

sources.grain: one session, event, span, blob descriptor, edge, or training-example descriptor
sources.notes: Private first-party OLTP source. The adapter snapshots consistently and retains blob hashes/descriptors, not prompt or response bodies. Consent, sensitivity, and redaction metadata remain necessary governance gates.

sources.grain: one evaluated model descriptor or one evaluation attempt
sources.notes: Private first-party evaluation measurements. Snippets and errors are reduced to hashes by the adapter; no upstream model-output redistribution rights are asserted.

sources.display_name: Chimera Router Decisions and Delayed Feedback
sources.grain: one route decision, candidate exposure, outcome revision, or pairwise comparison
sources.notes: Private first-party OLTP source, normally ~/.dsco/chimera_router/feedback.db. Outcomes are append-only revisions; request and generation identifiers are hashed where required.

sources.grain: one model descriptor, alias, and optional catalog benchmark observation
sources.notes: Official provider catalog with model IDs, canonical slugs, capabilities, context limits, and quoted prices. OpenRouter publishes service terms, not an SPDX data license; retain immutable snapshots and do not infer rights to third-party model descriptions.

sources.grain: one model-provider-endpoint snapshot
sources.notes: Official live endpoint metadata can include quoted prices, context limits, supported parameters, short-window latency, throughput, and uptime. Values are provider/platform telemetry rather than an SLA. The adapter ingests caller-supplied immutable JSON snapshots and makes no network request.

sources.grain: one exact case-sensitive inference-provider and local-model offer per generated catalog snapshot
sources.notes: Generated static provider catalog with exact provider/model identities, wire IDs, capabilities, context limits, and USD-per-million-token rates. Zero prices are unresolved free-or-unknown and the OpenRouter auto-router sentinel is mapped to NULL. The repository is MIT, but generated vendor metadata has no row-level rights provenance; pin file hash and commit before redistribution. Headers, base URLs, compat extraBody, signing endpoints, and free text are excluded.

sources.grain: one runtime process observation file
sources.notes: Private first-party process telemetry from runtime-*.json. The adapter excludes command lines, executable paths, working directories, node names, and free-text detail.

sources.grain: one child-process resource observation
sources.notes: Private first-party numeric process telemetry from child-metrics-*.jsonl. Stable row identity is derived from content and line position inside a content-addressed source snapshot.

sources.grain: one prompt-free transcript turn metric
sources.notes: Private first-party metrics from transcript-*.jsonl. The adapter retains timestamps, model/provider IDs, token counts, cost, and stop reason only; raw prompts and responses are not retained, and the transcript-last symlink alias is excluded.

sources.grain: one prompt-free tool invocation metric
sources.notes: Private first-party metrics from session tools.jsonl files. The adapter retains tool name, success, latency, and token count but never raw arguments or results; session identity falls back to a hash when directory naming is noncanonical.

sources.grain: one durable run identity and lifecycle snapshot
sources.notes: Private first-party run identity bridge. Only manifests pointing to the primary Chronicle are ingested; alternate and test roots are excluded. CWD and database, journal, and event-log paths are used only for classification and never retained.

sources.grain: one valid CRC-framed durable run event
sources.notes: Private first-party durable journal. The adapter verifies little-endian length and CRC-32 for every frame, stops at a corrupt or truncated tail, retains allowlisted lifecycle, cost, tool, trace, and token fields, and hashes but never stores raw payloads, tool arguments, previews, or paths.

sources.grain: one reviewed provider capability and policy snapshot
sources.notes: Private reviewed provider capability metadata. The adapter keeps typed confidence, risk, modality, tool, reasoning, caching, retry, and accounting capabilities; it excludes auth material, headers, URLs, paths, notes, quirks, and free-text policies. Provider identity is not automatically equated with a catalog model-vendor prefix.

sources.grain: one latest EMA aggregate per orchestration topology
sources.notes: Low-trust local prior from ~/.dsco/cost_model.jsonl. Join topology name to WAL agent_topology, never to model IDs. Most rows have few observations, many have zero latency, and some cost units appear contaminated; do not use as realized cost truth or live pricing until the unit contract and minimum support are repaired.

sources.grain: one immutable runtime incident record
sources.notes: About 213K local incident files, dominated by OOM and memory-restart events. A future streaming adapter should retain typed incident kind, time, PID, memory and restart metrics while hashing or dropping command lines, paths, hostnames, and crash text. PID-to-instance join coverage is low, so unmatched incidents remain first-class facts.

sources.grain: one child-agent result inside one swarm task directory
sources.notes: About 13.5K mutable last-write-wins child slot files across hundreds of parent-PID directories. The model is parent-requested and unverified, cost mixes reported and estimated fallback, file mtime is only an approximate completion time, and process exit is not semantic correctness. The adapter retains domain-separated task/output hashes and typed process metrics while dropping raw task/output text and marks degenerate groups unusable.

sources.grain: one task, scheduler event, or lane aggregate
sources.notes: Small, stale scheduler dataset with task state, attempts, lane calls/errors, EMA success and latency. Hash or drop task payloads, results, errors and event details. Join lanes to topology only through an explicit alias table; use as a weak orchestration prior, not promotion evidence.

sources.grain: one provider capacity and preflight state at one snapshot time
sources.notes: Intended provider capacity and preflight surface. The current file has zero provider rows, so ingestion is disabled until populated. Exclude credentials, account identifiers, raw headers, and free-text failures.

sources.grain: one model result for one versioned safety case
sources.notes: Small local safety-evaluation result set with already-hashed evidence. Normalize model aliases and retain case ID, harness version, pass/fail, process status, latency and cost; exclude prompts, generated text, logs and paths.

sources.display_name: DSCO Capability and Preflight Classifier Corpus
sources.grain: one labeled capability or multi-turn routing example
sources.notes: Large local capability/preflight corpus with material duplicates and prompt-hash leakage across existing splits. It must be deduplicated and group-split before any evaluation or router training; raw prompts remain outside the fusion warehouse, with only labels, stable hashes, split provenance and derived features admitted.

sources.grain: one real-world pairwise model comparison
sources.notes: About 136K downloadable preference rows. The card scopes CC-BY-4.0 to user prompts while model outputs remain governed by each provider, so no whole-row SPDX license is asserted. Normalize only vote, model, task/language metadata, and nonreversible request hashes; do not retain conversations.

sources.grain: one search-augmented conversation with an optional pairwise vote
sources.notes: 24,069 conversations and 12,652 votes in roughly 401 MB. The publisher reports PII redaction and consent, but prompts alone are CC-BY-4.0 and model outputs follow provider terms. Strip messages and search traces before normalization.

sources.grain: one repository-grounded pairwise model comparison
sources.notes: 3,844 comparisons, roughly 482 MB. User prompts are CC-BY-4.0, model outputs follow provider terms, and embedded GitHub repository material retains upstream licenses. Normalize votes and repository/language categories only; exclude conversations and repository content.

sources.grain: one web-development pairwise model comparison
sources.notes: About 10.5K comparisons under custom, gated terms rather than an SPDX license. Access is nontransferable and nonsublicensable; obtain and preserve the accepted terms before use. Normalize labels and task metadata only, with no HTML, prompts, or model outputs.

sources.grain: one model-category-time leaderboard observation
sources.notes: Official downloadable leaderboard history with roughly two million aggregate rows. Treat rankings as time-varying observations, preserve category and date, and pin dataset revisions to avoid look-ahead leakage.

sources.grain: one prompt-model quality, cost, or routing observation
sources.notes: More than 30K prompts across 11 models, approximately 1.47 GB. The repository code is MIT, but that does not establish rights for the downloadable dataset artifact. Pickle is executable serialization: convert only in an isolated, unprivileged environment, then emit prompt-free normalized JSONL.

sources.grain: one judge-labeled pairwise model comparison
sources.notes: Approximately 109K judge-labeled comparisons intended for router training. Keep judge provenance distinct from human preference, pin the dataset revision, hash request content, and exclude prompts and model outputs from the warehouse.

sources.grain: one model-task judgment
sources.notes: Roughly 60K judgment rows spanning changing benchmark releases. The dataset card does not state a single dataset license and some tasks have upstream rights; retain only scores, task IDs, versions, and provenance after legal review.

sources.grain: one model-evaluation aggregate score
sources.notes: Small downloadable aggregate table, currently about 105 rows. Useful as a cross-check, not a prompt-level training corpus; preserve evaluation version and sample count. The dataset card currently states no dataset license, so no SPDX rights are asserted.

sources.grain: one model metric observation at an API retrieval time
sources.notes: Official API offers independent quality, price, latency, and throughput metrics subject to plan limits and attribution/redistribution terms. No SPDX data license is stated; cache or republish only as permitted by the applicable contract. Preserve retrieval time and methodology version.

sources.grain: one model-task-category score or execution result
sources.notes: Several thousand function-calling tasks and official result artifacts. Normalize category scores and validity outcomes; preserve benchmark version, model alias, and execution versus nonexecution mode.

sources.grain: one model-run result for one verified repository issue
sources.notes: 500 verified tasks plus official experiment result files. No single dataset SPDX license is stated, and issue text and repository code retain upstream rights. Ingest only task IDs, model/run metadata, resolution status, cost/latency where published, and provenance.

sources.grain: one agent-model run for one terminal task
sources.notes: Terminal-Bench 2.0 contains 89 tasks plus official result artifacts. Pin the task-set and harness versions; container images and bundled fixtures may carry additional licenses even though the repository is Apache-2.0.

sources.grain: one agent-user simulation trial for one task
sources.notes: The official repository now publishes Tau3-Bench while retaining the tau2-bench repository name. It includes multi-turn text, knowledge, and voice-agent evaluation. Pin an immutable release because grading and task definitions evolve; retain domain, modality, task, trial, reward, and error taxonomy but exclude dialogues and audio.

sources.grain: one model evaluation for one coding task
sources.notes: 1,140 coding tasks with release JSONL and Hugging Face Parquet access. The official repository is archived, so pin the final revision and treat it as static; ingest pass/fail and aggregate metrics rather than generated code.
